evidence.reason: At the pinned tip the try/except at lines 799-805 still protects only `self.push(head, commit)`. The post-push `head, values = self.fetch()` at line 806 remains outside it, so a `SubprocessError`/`TimeoutExpired` from that fetch bypasses `last_error` and the final pending-publication `IntegrityError` path. This is an ordinary error-path correctness defect, not a new requirement, and the history does not show it fixed. Moving the fetch into the existing try block is the smallest compatible repair.
